setup.title: Install Chemins du Soleil
setup.intro: Chemins du Soleil works on almost any device. Pick yours below for step-by-step instructions. Once installed, route-finding keeps working offline on the mountain.
setup.step.ambientBadge: Look for the install icon at the right end of the address bar and select it.
setup.step.done: Chemins du Soleil opens in its own window and appears alongside your other apps.
setup.note.chromeMenu: No icon? In Chrome, open the ⋮ menu and choose {path}.
setup.note.edgeMenu: In Edge, open the … menu and choose {path}.
setup.web.intro: No installation needed: Chemins du Soleil runs in any modern browser.
setup.web.step2: Bookmark the page so it's always one tap away.
setup.web.step3: After your first visit, route-finding works offline too, even with no signal on the slopes.
setup.android.store: The easiest way: get Chemins du Soleil from Google Play.
setup.android.banner: Tap {install} when the install banner appears at the bottom of the screen.
setup.android.menu: No banner? Open the browser menu, choose {add}, then {install}.
setup.android.firefox: In Firefox, open the ⋮ menu and choose {add}.
setup.windows.store: The easiest way: get Chemins du Soleil from the Microsoft Store.
setup.windows.firefox: Select the {label} icon at the right end of the address bar.
setup.macos.safari: Choose {path} from the menu bar, then {add} (macOS Sonoma or later).
setup.note.firefox: Firefox can't install web apps on {platform} yet, but you don't need to: Chemins du Soleil works right in the browser, and offline too after your first visit. Bookmark it to keep it one click away.
setup.ios.step2: Tap the {share} button (a square with an arrow pointing up). If you don't see it, tap ⋯ first.
setup.ios.step3: Scroll down the Share sheet and tap {add}.
setup.ios.step4: If shown, leave {webApp} switched on, then tap {add}.
setup.ios.step5: Chemins du Soleil now has its own icon on your Home Screen. Open it from there.
setup.ios.otherBrowsers: On iOS 16.4 and later, Chrome, Edge and Firefox can do this too: use their Share button and follow the same steps.
setup.ui.chromeMenuPath: Cast, save, and share › Install page as app
